dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Barkin is at risk due to behavioral reasons. He has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to thrash intensely while on leash. This behavior is not easily redirected and handlers have needed a sling to return him to kennel. During his medical exam Barkin was receptive to baby food. Medically, Barkin is apparently healthy.

Barkin has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to thrash intensely while on leash. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an adult only home.
